description: This file defines the DashboardFragment class for an Android application. It manages the UI components for a calculator dashboard, including input fields for operands, operation buttons, and result/error display. It interacts with a ViewModel to perform calculations and update the UI accordingly.

classes.name: DashboardFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that handles the calculator UI and user interactions for performing arithmetic operations.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the fragment's view has been created. Sets up UI references, observers for ViewModel LiveData, and button click listeners.

methods.name: currentA
methods.description: Helper function to get the current text value from operand A input field.

methods.name: currentB
methods.description: Helper function to get the current text value from operand B input field.
